id: \rI'm so nervous. I've never seen a champion before.
en: \rI'm so nervous. I've never seen a champion before.
it: \rChe ansia. Non ho mai visto un Campione dal vivo.

id: \rHmph. You're not even a warm up.
en: \rHmph. You're not even a warm up.
it: \rPff. Non vali nemmeno come riscaldamento.

id: \rThis won't be enough to stop me. You caught me on a bad day.
en: \rThis won't be enough to stop me. You caught me on a bad day.
it: \rNon basterà a fermarmi. Mi hai beccato in una giornataccia.

id: \bWallace: Ah \PN, you came. I'm glad to see that.
en: \bWallace: Ah \PN, you came. I'm glad to see that.
it: \bAdriano: Ah, \PN, sei venuto. Ne sono lieto.

id: \bPerhaps you might be interested in learning a move to help you out.
en: \bPerhaps you might be interested in learning a move to help you out.
it: \bForse ti interesserebbe imparare una mossa che ti dia una mano.

id: \bIt's a move that my Milotic and I often use, Aqua Tail. Would you like to learn it?
en: \bIt's a move that my Milotic and I often use, Aqua Tail.  Would you like to learn it?
it: \bÈ una mossa che io e il mio Milotic usiamo spesso: Idrondata. Vuoi impararla?

id: \bNo time like the present. Let's get some practice in.
en: \bNo time like the present. Let's get some practice in.
it: \bNon c'è momento migliore di adesso. Facciamo un po' di pratica.

id: \bThanks. Hopefully I don't lose in the first round.
en: \bThanks. Hopefully I don't lose in the first round.
it: \bGrazie. Speriamo di non perdere al primo turno.

id: \rWelcome. I'll be able to register you in a minute.
en: \rWelcome. I'll be able to register you in a minute.
it: \rBenvenuto. Tra un minuto potrò registrarti.

id: \rWelcome. You're just in time to enter our Contest. Are you ready?
en: \rWelcome. You're just in time to enter our Contest.  Are you ready?
it: \rBenvenuto. Sei appena in tempo per iscriverti alla nostra Gara. Sei pronto?

id: \rPlease come again.
en: \rPlease come again.
it: \rTorna a trovarci.

id: \rThank you for entering.
en: \rThank you for entering.
it: \rGrazie per aver partecipato.

id: \rDawn: Hi \PN. Are you entering the Contest too? No need to worry, you'll do great.
en: \rDawn: Hi \PN. Are you entering the Contest too? No need to worry, you'll do great.
it: \rLucinda: Ciao, \PN. Partecipi anche tu alla Gara? Niente paura, andrai alla grande.

id: \rDawn: I won the Contest!! I can't believe I did it.
en: \rDawn: I won the Contest!! I can't believe I did it.
it: \rLucinda: Ho vinto la Gara!! Non ci posso credere, ce l'ho fatta.

id: \rDawn: Did you come to wish me luck? No need to worry, I've got this in the bag.
en: \rDawn: Did you come to wish me luck? No need to worry, I've got this in the bag.
it: \rLucinda: Sei venuto ad augurarmi buona fortuna? Niente paura, ce l'ho in tasca.

id: \rYou should focus on your gym battle. Where is it at, Sunnyshore City? I'll meet up with you and tell you what happened.
en: \rYou should focus on your gym battle. Where is it at, Sunnyshore City? I'll meet up with you and tell you what happened.
it: \rTu pensa alla tua lotta in Palestra. Dov'è, ad Arenipoli? Ti raggiungo dopo e ti racconto com'è andata.

id: \bFor the Performance Stage I'll be judging your Pokémon.
en: \bFor the Performance Stage I'll be judging your Pokémon.
it: \bNella Fase Esibizione giudicherò io i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \b...Oh? You don't need me to judge. I get it.
en: \b...Oh? You don't need me to judge. I get it.
it: \b...Oh? Non ti serve il mio giudizio. Capisco.

id: \bI see, I see...
en: \bI see, I see...
it: \bVedo, vedo...

id: \bThis Pokémon's potential is outstanding overall.
en: \bThis Pokémon's potential is outstanding overall.
it: \bNel complesso, il potenziale di questo Pokémon è eccezionale.

id: \bThis Pokémon's potential is relatively superior overall.
en: \bThis Pokémon's potential is relatively superior overall.
it: \bNel complesso, il potenziale di questo Pokémon è decisamente superiore.

id: \bThis Pokémon's potential is above average overall.
en: \bThis Pokémon's potential is above average overall.
it: \bNel complesso, il potenziale di questo Pokémon è sopra la media.

id: \bThis Pokémon's potential is decent overall.
en: \bThis Pokémon's potential is decent overall.
it: \bNel complesso, il potenziale di questo Pokémon è discreto.

id: \bThat's my determination, and it's final.
en: \bThat's my determination, and it's final.
it: \bQuesto è il mio verdetto, ed è definitivo.

id: \bIncidentally, I would say the best potential lies in its \v[4] stat.
en: \bIncidentally, I would say the best potential lies in its \v[4] stat.
it: \bTra l'altro, direi che il potenziale migliore sta nella statistica \v[4].

id: \bAnd its Attack stat is also good.
en: \bAnd its Attack stat is also good.
it: \bE anche il suo Attacco è buono.

id: \bI see, its Defense stat is also good.
en: \bI see, its Defense stat is also good.
it: \bVedo, anche la sua Difesa è buona.

id: \bWell, its Speed stat is also good.
en: \bWell, its Speed stat is also good.
it: \bBeh, anche la sua Velocità è buona.

id: \bIts Special Attack stat is equally good.
en: \bIts Special Attack stat is equally good.
it: \bAnche il suo Attacco Speciale è altrettanto buono.

id: \bIts Special Defense stat is good as well.
en: \bIts Special Defense stat is good as well.
it: \bAnche la sua Difesa Speciale è buona.

id: \bIt can't be better in that regard. That's how I judged it.
en: \bIt can't be better in that regard. That's how I judged it.
it: \bSotto quell'aspetto non potrebbe essere migliore. Questo è il mio giudizio.

id: \bIt's fantastic in that regard. That's how I judged it.
en: \bIt's fantastic in that regard. That's how I judged it.
it: \bSotto quell'aspetto è fantastico. Questo è il mio giudizio.

id: \bIt's very good in that regard. That's how I judged it.
en: \bIt's very good in that regard. That's how I judged it.
it: \bSotto quell'aspetto è molto buono. Questo è il mio giudizio.

id: \bIt's rather decent in that regard. That's how I judged it.
en: \bIt's rather decent in that regard. That's how I judged it.
it: \bSotto quell'aspetto è piuttosto discreto. Questo è il mio giudizio.

id: \bLooks like the judges agree. Congratulations, you're moving on to the Battle Stage.
en: \bLooks like the judges agree. Congratulations, you're moving on to the Battle Stage.
it: \bA quanto pare i giudici sono d'accordo. Congratulazioni, passi alla Fase Lotta.

id: \bI wish you luck. You'll need it.
en: \bI wish you luck. You'll need it.
it: \bTi auguro buona fortuna. Ne avrai bisogno.

id: \bThat's the battle. The judges are now giving their scores and...
en: \bThat's the battle. The judges are now giving their scores and...
it: \bE la lotta è finita. I giudici stanno assegnando i punteggi e...

id: \bContestant \PN wins by a landslide! They'll be moving on to round 2.
en: \bContestant \PN wins by a landslide! They'll be moving on to round 2.
it: \bIl concorrente \PN vince con un distacco enorme! Passa al secondo turno.

id: \rGood to see you again.
en: \rGood to see you again.
it: \rChe bello rivederti.

id: \rI'm impressed. I see where Dawn gets some of her talent.
en: \rI'm impressed. I see where Dawn gets some of her talent.
it: \rSono colpita. Ora capisco da chi Lucinda ha preso un po' del suo talento.

id: \rMay: Good to see you \PN. I met your friend Dawn and I'm impressed with her skill.
en: \rMay: Good to see you \PN. I met your friend Dawn and I'm impressed with her skill.
it: \rVera: Che bello vederti, \PN. Ho conosciuto la tua amica Lucinda e sono rimasta colpita dalla sua bravura.

id: \rI need to train a bit more, so no one could help more than you. Hope you're ready.
en: \rI need to train a bit more, so no one could help more than you. Hope you're ready.
it: \rDevo allenarmi ancora un po', e nessuno può aiutarmi meglio di te. Spero tu sia pronto.

id: \rMay: You never did let up on me. I'm really glad I got to run into you here.
en: \rMay: You never did let up on me. I'm really glad I got to run into you here.
it: \rVera: Non mi hai mai dato tregua. Sono davvero contenta di averti incontrato qui.

id: \rMay: Maybe we'll meet up and face each other in the Contest.
en: \rMay: Maybe we'll meet up and face each other in the Contest.
it: \rVera: Magari ci ritroveremo una contro l'altro alla Gara.

id: \rMay: Go earn your next badge \PN. I'm sure you're looking forward to it.
en: \rMay: Go earn your next badge \PN. I'm sure you're looking forward to it.
it: \rVera: Vai a prenderti la prossima medaglia, \PN. Scommetto che non vedi l'ora.

id: \rUm, do you need something? Weirdo...
en: \rUm, do you need something? Weirdo...
it: \rEhm, ti serve qualcosa? Che tipo strano...

id: \bI wanted to enter the contest. I got too scared in the end...
en: \bI wanted to enter the contest. I got too scared in the end...
it: \bVolevo partecipare alla Gara. Alla fine mi sono fatto prendere dalla paura...

id: \bI've seen your performance. This should be easy.
en: \bI've seen your performance. This should be easy.
it: \bHo visto la tua esibizione. Sarà una passeggiata.

id: \bContestant Kyle wins! He'll be moving on to round 3.
en: \bContestant Kyle wins! He'll be moving on to round 3.
it: \bVince il concorrente Kyle! Passa al terzo turno.

id: \rThank you for competing. Please take this as a participation reward.
en: \rThank you for competing. Please take this as a participation reward.
it: \rGrazie per aver partecipato. Accetta questo come premio di partecipazione.

id: \bAh, \PN, a pleasure to meet you again. Perhaps we have time for a quick battle.
en: \bAh, \PN, a pleasure to meet you again. Perhaps we have time for a quick battle.
it: \bAh, \PN, che piacere rivederti. Forse abbiamo tempo per una lotta veloce.

id: \bWish me luck in the Contest. I will hopefully see you at the Sinnoh League.
en: \bWish me luck in the Contest. I will hopefully see you at the Sinnoh League.
it: \bAugurami buona fortuna per la Gara. Spero di rivederti alla Lega di Sinnoh.

id: \bThe contest lets you use the ribbon in any region. What a lucky item that is to have.
en: \bThe contest lets you use the ribbon in any region.  What a lucky item that is to have.
it: \bIl fiocco della Gara si può usare in qualsiasi regione. Che fortuna averne uno.

id: Yes
en: Yes
it: Sì

id: No
en: No
it: No
